purpose: Record the finished D2 task corpus: that it meets the group floor S21D2-014 raised, that the recipe no longer predicts the verifier's answer, and that no task or candidate is a restatement of a C3 one.

recipe_oracle_removed.method: The recipe carried by each authored variant is a per-task permutation derived from the template id, so the recipe is uninformative about correctness.

executed_verification.note: Every verdict below is an executed pytest run, not a declaration.

checks: normalised AST with identifiers and literals erased
token stream with names and literals canonicalised
every D2 variant against every C3 candidate, not only baseline against baseline

authoring_cost.projection_published_in_the_wave_plan: About 34 further defect-and-repair cycles, extrapolating the probe's 40 percent rate across the remaining 85 templates.
authoring_cost.projection_outcome: overstated by roughly a factor of six
authoring_cost.why_the_projection_was_wrong: The probe's rate measured authoring without knowing the rules; the four defects it found were what taught them. Extrapolating a first-attempt rate past the point where the lesson lands overstates the remaining cost.

defects_that_only_execution_or_the_detec.detail: Two variants differed only in indentation, which the normaliser drops because those tokens strip to empty.
An empty prefix was handled by accident: startswith('') is always true.
The declared floating-point drift did not occur for the chosen bounds, so a variant declared incomplete actually repaired the contract.

Its minimal repair was byte-identical to C3 merge_settings incomplete_a, so the task was already solved in the inherited corpus. Replaced outright, because reshaping the variant would not change which three lines solve it.

constraints_honoured: No C3 or D1 observation was read, fitted or calibrated against.
No development, C3 or D1 artifact store was written.
The declaration of which variant repairs the contract is provenance, never a feature.
No campaign was run: this records the corpus, not any outcome.
